details: Lots of content creators have a quest and the quest has a recording feature built into the headset, but vrchat only has screenshots and photo camera... no video camera, and with PC gamers it requires downloading additional software to even use the stream camera function. My proposal is to make a video camera that is optimized for all users, one that is simple to use and doesn't require extra software outside of a video editor to use in game. why should it be implemented? well first, it would be easier on pc users as they dont have to take off their headset to see whatever streaming software they use to record, they can just prepare and shoot their vids accordingly. and secondly it would be more accessible to people who have a quest and link cable, but dont have the money for a 1500 dollar gaming desktop computer and would LOVE the option to do it without linking to a computer to use such a function. not to mention people who have a quest and do tiktok or youtube videos REEEEEAAAALLY want a video recording option in game. if any of the devs see this, hope this feedback influenced a possible decision.
title: Make an Optimized Video Camera interface For all types of users
